title: unmapped XSUAA identity is denied safely
runtime: SAP BTP Cloud Foundry / AppRouter / XSUAA / HANA Cloud

runtimeEvidence.authServiceMe: Chrome DevTools: HTTP 403 application/json during normal app load
runtimeEvidence.roleRollback: BTP readback: zero role collections after temporary role removal

testCommand: Chrome Browser Control signed-in BTP session; BTP role readback before and after rollback
actualResult: An authorized disposable BTP shadow identity signed in through the live Chrome session. Chrome DevTools observed the app AuthService.me request return HTTP 403 with application/json, and the page rendered the safe access-denied message. The service rejects a missing active external-identity mapping with HTTP 403. The temporary IDTS_TESTER role was removed and the BTP readback shows zero role collections. No IDTS user, Bug, attachment, notification, or business data was created, changed, or removed.
assertions: An authorized disposable BTP shadow identity was created only by the temporary IDTS_TESTER role assignment.
Chrome DevTools observed the live AuthService.me request return HTTP 403 with application/json.
The signed-in live Chrome session displayed the exact safe access-denied UI text.
auth-guard.js invokes AuthService.me and displays that exact text for the 403 branch.
btpUserProfile rejects a missing active external-identity mapping with HTTP 403.
The temporary IDTS_TESTER role was removed; BTP readback has zero role collections.
No IDTS user mapping or business mutation was issued for this execution.
limitations: Direct endpoint navigation is blocked by Chrome client policy, but the normal app-load request was captured with Chrome DevTools as HTTP 403 application/json. The BTP shadow user remains with zero role collections; it was not deleted because that external-account deletion is outside the approved rollback scope.
